definitions.name: O2C.DIVISORS
definitions.body: 'N' BIND 1 N RANGE [ 'D' BIND N D DIV FLOOR D MUL N EQ ] FILTER
definitions.note: Vector of the positive divisors of the integer on the stack, ascending

definitions.name: O2C.ISPRIME
definitions.note: TRUE when the integer on the stack has exactly two divisors

definitions.name: O2C.MEDIAN
definitions.body: 'V' BIND V SORT 'S' BIND V LENGTH 'N' BIND S N 1 SUB 2 DIV FLOOR N 2 DIV FLOOR 2 COLLECT GET G0A.MEAN
definitions.note: median of a Vector of numbers (mean of the two middle values when even)

definitions.name: O2C.VAR
definitions.body: 'V' BIND V G0A.MEAN 'M' BIND V [ M SUB 'X' BIND X X MUL ] MAP G0A.MEAN
definitions.note: population variance of a Vector of numbers

definitions.name: O2C.BINARY
definitions.body: 'N' BIND 5 0 RANGE [ 'I' BIND N 2 I POW DIV FLOOR 'Q' BIND Q Q 2 DIV FLOOR 2 MUL SUB STR '' 0 Q LT SELECT ] MAP JOIN
definitions.note: binary digits of an integer from 1 to 63 as a String, no leading zeros

definitions.name: O2C.COLLATZ
definitions.body: 'N' BIND N 1 COLLECT 0 199 RANGE N [ 'E' BIND 'X' BIND X X 2 DIV FLOOR X 3 MUL 1 ADD X X 2 DIV FLOOR 2 MUL SUB 0 EQ SELECT X 1 EQ SELECT ] SCAN CONCAT [ 1 EQ NOT ] FILTER LENGTH
definitions.note: Collatz steps to reach 1, from a 200-step SCAN trajectory that holds at 1; counts the trajectory values not equal to 1

definitions.name: O2C.FIBIDX
definitions.note: smallest k with F(k) at least the integer on the stack, by counting the Fibonacci numbers below it

definitions.name: O2C.LINE
definitions.body: 'O' BIND O 'qty' GET 0 O 'price' GET O 'price' GET NIL? SELECT MUL
definitions.note: qty times price of one order Record; 0 when the order has no price

definitions.name: O2C.ORDERS
definitions.note: JSON text on the stack to the Vector of order Records under the orders key

definitions.name: O2C.REVENUE
definitions.note: total of qty times price over a Vector of order Records, unpriced orders contributing 0

definitions.name: O2C.GROUPSUM
definitions.body: GROUP 'G' BIND G KEYS G VALUES [ G0A.SUM ] MAP RECORD
definitions.note: keys Vector and values Vector to a Record from each key to the sum of its values, keys in first-appearance order

definitions.name: O2C.QTYSKU
definitions.body: 'OS' BIND OS [ 'sku' GET ] MAP OS [ 'qty' GET ] MAP O2C.GROUPSUM
definitions.note: Vector of order Records to a Record from sku to the sum of its qty

definitions.name: O2C.BYNAME
definitions.body: 'L' BIND L [ 0 GET ] MAP L [ 1 GET ] MAP O2C.GROUPSUM
definitions.note: Vector of [name amount] entries to a Record from each name to its summed amount, names in first-appearance order

solutions.ledger.debtors: O2C.BYNAME 'R' BIND R KEYS [ 'K' BIND R K GET 0 LT ] FILTER
solutions.ledger.largest_entry: 'L' BIND L L [ 1 GET ] MAP G0A.ARGMAX GET
solutions.messy.title: G0A.WORDS [ LOWER G0B.CAP ] MAP G0B.SPACED
solutions.messy.sorted_unique: G0A.WORDS [ LOWER ] MAP UNIQUE SORT G0B.SPACED
solutions.number.digital_root: 'N' BIND N N 1 SUB 9 DIV FLOOR 9 MUL SUB
solutions.orders.unpriced: O2C.ORDERS [ 'price' GET NIL? ] FILTER [ 'sku' GET ] MAP UNIQUE
solutions.orders.tag_counts: O2C.ORDERS [ 'tags' GET ] MAP O1D.PRESENT [ UNIQUE ] MAP FLATTEN TALLY
solutions.series.mad: 'V' BIND V O2C.MEDIAN 'M' BIND V [ M SUB ] MAP [ 'X' BIND X X -1 MUL MAX ] MAP O2C.MEDIAN
solutions.series.moving3: 'V' BIND V -2 DROP V 1 DROP -1 DROP ADD V 2 DROP ADD 3 DIV
solutions.series.runmax: 'V' BIND V V 0 GET [ MAX ] SCAN
solutions.series.mode: 'V' BIND V TALLY 'T' BIND T KEYS SORT 'K' BIND T K GET 'C' BIND K C G0A.ARGMAX GET
solutions.stats.deviations: 'V' BIND V G0A.MEAN 'M' BIND V [ M SUB ] MAP
solutions.stats.range: SORT 'S' BIND S -1 GET S 0 GET SUB
solutions.stats.normalize: 'V' BIND V SORT 'S' BIND S -1 GET 'MX' BIND S 0 GET 'MN' BIND V [ MN SUB MX MN SUB DIV ] MAP
solutions.text.acronym: G0A.WORDS [ CHARS 0 GET UPPER ] MAP JOIN
